interpretations.title: Puzzle frustration often comes with unclear guidance
interpretations.claim: Among non-recommending players, negative puzzle-design and guidance mentions frequently occur in the same reviews. The pattern suggests that some frustration may concern understanding objectives or rules—not simply difficulty.
interpretations.basis: Count unique non-recommended reviews with negative puzzle-design, guidance and difficulty tag sentiments; inspect their overlap and named-puzzle co-mentions.
interpretations.limitations: A co-mention does not establish which specific puzzle caused a complaint, nor does it prove a causal relationship.
